args.question: Please provide the cardholder statement for this transaction.

args.narrative: The transaction was authorized and approved (auth code 543641) and a receipt for 40.16 USD was issued on 2026-02-02. The cardholder states they did not make this purchase. The merchant does not hold AVS/CVV match or device/IP match records for this transaction, so the required fraud-monitoring evidence is not included.

args.explanation: Fraud dispute 10.5 on USD 40.16 (seed 6003). Read the case, the receipt and authorization record, and the ledger. Asked the issuer for the statement; the cardholder said they did not make the purchase. I held no AVS/CVV match or device/IP match records, so I represented on 2026-02-12 with the receipt and authorization record and stated those gaps. The case moved to pre-arbitration. Mistake: I advanced time with a single 30-day wait and did not check the pre-arbitration window, so the response deadline of 2026-03-05 was missed and the case resolved against the merchant. The merchant bears the 40.16 USD chargeback plus 15.00 USD processor and 25.00 USD network fees.
